title: Seven Falls Hiking Tour at Silver Falls State Park
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience Oregon’s crown jewel of state parks on this guided hiking tour of Silver Falls. Known as the ""crown jewel of the Oregon State Parks system,"" Silver Falls features the famed Trail of Ten Falls, and this route takes you on the most rewarding Winter Falls Loop.

Over the course of a 5-mile loop hike with about 400 ft of elevation gain, you’ll see 7 waterfalls, including Double Falls, the park's tallest at 178 feet. You’ll walk behind three waterfalls, stand in lush canyon grottos, and feel the mist on your face. The trail transitions from mixed conifer forest on the rim into the dramatic basalt-walled canyon below, giving you a full spectrum of Oregon’s natural beauty.

Your professional local guides bring the park to life with stories of its geology, history, and wildlife. Transportation to and from Portland is included in your comfortable vans.
